ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Digital Libraries: Research & Practice] LEEP students; Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@illinois.edu); Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.continuinged.illinois.edu/outreach/. Required on-campus session Monday, Oct. 18. Prerequisites: LIS 501 (or consent of instructor in extraordinary circumstances); Previous or concurrent enrollment in LIS 452 or proof of competency in programming; Students should have access to a personal computer upon which they can experiment on their own with downloaded software tools. Students must be competent in basic computing including the installation and configuration of software packages. [Required core course for the CAS in Digital Libraries concentration]
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC or MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC.
